# The API generated code may call (TestContract, docs/design/library.md).

# public: documented API a person writes by hand.
# stepN: an internal form generated code still calls, until step N of the
# Plan in docs/design/library.md gives it a public replacement. Delete an
# entry when its step lands; one no golden uses fails the test.

# Kept from step 3, made public: what has no schema method to go in.
# RegisterFields is the field attributes of a struct embedding neither
# orm.Base nor ui.Live (read back with FieldAttrsOf). StaticOf, Static and
# Statics are a static of a generic type, one value per instantiation,
# which a package-level variable can't be.
public github.com/vuka-lang/vuka.RegisterFields
public github.com/vuka-lang/vuka.Static
public github.com/vuka-lang/vuka.StaticOf
public github.com/vuka-lang/vuka.Statics

# Step 3 replaced field attribute registrations, field references and
# statics for types with a schema (orm.Base, ui.Live): their Schema and
# LiveSchema methods, <Model>Fields, plain Go names. A field reference on a
# struct with no generated typed fields still lowers to an index path;
# its public form (a field named by address) is a follow-up.
step3 github.com/vuka-lang/vuka.CompareRefOf
step3 github.com/vuka-lang/vuka.NullableRefOf
step3 github.com/vuka-lang/vuka.OrderedRefOf
step3 github.com/vuka-lang/vuka.RefOf
step3 github.com/vuka-lang/vuka.StringRefOf

# Step 4: call decorators (func(*vuka.Call)) run through an adapter
# written for each function's signature, NewCall packing the call into a
# vuka.Call described by a vuka.Func. Its public form is a reflective
# wrapper beside the other fallbacks of step 4, the typed adapter becoming
# an optional speed-up.
step4 github.com/vuka-lang/vuka.Func
step4 github.com/vuka-lang/vuka.NewCall
